AbilityMode.Name: Mana ability
AbilityMode.Hint: Which modifier increases mana. "Per class" uses each class's entry (editable in "Mana tables").
AbilityMode.Class: Per class (INT or WIS depending on class)

IncludeSpecies.Name: Species traits cost mana
IncludeSpecies.Hint: If enabled, species traits with limited uses (e.g. Breath Weapon) also cost mana.

IncludeFeats.Name: Feats cost mana
IncludeFeats.Hint: If enabled, feats with limited uses also cost mana.

NPCs.Name: Apply to NPCs
NPCs.Hint: If enabled, spellcasting NPCs also use mana (based on spellcaster level).

Rules.Name: Mana tables
Rules.Label: Edit tables (JSON)
Rules.Title: Mana System — Tables and costs
Rules.Hint: Edit the tables per class category, spell costs per level, the cost of each class feature (-1 = don't convert) and species bonuses.

RestCondition.Name: Rest condition
RestCondition.Hint: Normal: long 40%, short 15%. Comfortable: long full. Desperate: long 33%, short none.

requireFocus.Name: Require a focus to cast
requireFocus.Hint: Characters need an equipped focus. Material components and gold costs are ignored.

requireVerbal.Name: Require speech
requireVerbal.Hint: Silenced, unconscious, paralyzed, petrified or stunned characters can't cast.

requireSight.Name: Require sight of the target
requireSight.Hint: Blinded characters can only cast self or touch spells.

HitDice.Title: Recover mana — {name}
HitDice.Hint: Short rest ({cond}). Mana: {value}/{max}. Available: {dice}. Each die restores {pct}% of the roll as mana.

Rest.Title: Rest condition
